note: Two live mock-server sends reuse one address-keyed channel generation; stale version close is ignored, CloseAddr removes the channel, and the next send creates generation two. Multi-connection selection, batch enablement, eager dialing, and concurrent pool creation remain open.

CloseAddr removes the current channel and permits lazy recreation while terminal Close removes all channels and makes every later send return the typed closed error. Tonic Channel shutdown observation and in-flight cancellation remain open.

Zero and delayed caller deadlines return a transport-neutral typed timeout with the exact selected address and generation; malformed bodies and invalid addresses fail in their own typed families. Go pointer identity and arbitrary wrapped-cause traversal remain open.
